shortDescription: Russian largest gold producer Polyus RUS:PLZL:

children: Adjusted net profit was $829 million in H1 2026, down 59% from a year earlier;
Confirms its 2026 capital expenditure guidance of $2.2 billion-$2.5 billion.
Reaffirms its previously announced production guidance of 2.5 million-2.6 million ounces.
